rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: TaskFlow is a workflow orchestration platform designed for AI agents, providing a Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint with scope-based permissions, argument allowlists, and sandboxed shell=False execution. Agents can trigger and monitor jobs via Server-Sent Events for real-time stdout/stderr streaming, while an append-only hash-chained audit log ensures tamper-evident records of all operations. The platform includes a frontend dashboard and backend with 16 test cases covering DAG validation, rate limiting, and audit chain integrity.
